method: Same container, fresh Node processes ×3 per version, same old harness and full old fixture input retained for comparable RSS. No concurrent tests/browser. Module import separate, generation excludes import/startup; explicit query follows repeat. p95 with n=3 is sample max. Separate --expose-gc order-only conditions probe cold/warm hit/all target caches cleared/changed seed, CPU/heap/serialization/query; not pooled with the three-sample timings. Extra architecture n=1 each and small instrumentation-off samples, not a statistical overhead isolation.
